title: Weekly Personal Ops Review
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(score) as avg_score, min(score) as worst, max(score) as best by _time
| sort - _time
description: Produces a weekly summary of your life score, mirroring the ops review teams run on their systems.
value: A regular personal review builds the habit of reflecting and adjusting, the real value behind all the tracking.
implementation: Aggregate your life score weekly in `index=personal`; review average, best, and worst.
visualization: Column chart of weekly life-score summary.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you a weekly summary of how things went, like a team's regular review but for your own life.
